I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent market data.

As of the last few days, the U.S. dollar (USD) has been trading roughly around **£1 = $1.30–$1.35**. Using that range:

| USD | Approx. GBP |
|-----|-------------|
| $20 | £14.80–£15.38 |

So, $20 is roughly **£15** (give or take a few pence).  

If you need a precise, up‑to‑minute conversion, you’ll want to check a reliable financial news site, a currency‑conversion app, or your bank’s foreign‑exchange service.
